# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policies (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_policies` data source to find available policies

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policies" "example" {}

output "policies" {
  value = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policies.example.policies
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `managing_account` (String) Filter by managing account ID
- `policies` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--policies))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

- `consuming_account` (String) Consuming account ID
- `entries` (Block List) List of policy entries (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--policies--entries))
- `managing_account` (String) Managing account ID
- `name` (String) Name of the policy

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

### Nested Schema for `policies.entries`

Optional:

- `match_prefix_list` (String) Name of the prefix list to match
- `sequence_number` (Number) Sequence number for the policy entry

<a id="nestedblock--policies--entries--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies.entries.action`

Optional:

- `filter` (String) Filter action: accept, reject, or continue
- `local_preference` (Number) BGP local preference value

<a id="nestedblock--policies--entries--action--as_path_prepend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies.entries.action.as_path_prepend`

Optional:

- `asn` (Number) AS number to prepend (defaults to local ASN)
- `count` (Number) Number of times to prepend the ASN
